Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs

experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll

## RNA 2D Inverse Folding

Design RNA sequences that fold into a target secondary structure (inverse folding).

Exact job name: `rna_inverse_fold`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `n_gen` | integer | yes | value | Number of candidate sequences — pass as an INTEGER (`5`), **not** a string (differs from other RNA tools) |
| `struct_name` | string | yes | value | Structure template label; e.g. `"vienna_simple_hairpin"` |
| `second_struct` | string | yes | value | Target secondary structure in dot-bracket notation; e.g. `"(((.(((....))).)))"` |
| `target_seq` | string | yes | value | Seed / target RNA sequence; e.g. `"GGGGGGGAAAACCCACCC"` |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "n_gen": {
      "description": "Number of candidate sequences — pass as an INTEGER (`5`), **not** a string (differs from other RNA tools)",
      "type": "integer",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "struct_name": {
      "description": "Structure template label; e.g. `\"vienna_simple_hairpin\"`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "second_struct": {
      "description": "Target secondary structure in dot-bracket notation; e.g. `\"(((.(((....))).)))\"`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "target_seq": {
      "description": "Seed / target RNA sequence; e.g. `\"GGGGGGGAAAACCCACCC\"`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "n_gen",
    "struct_name",
    "second_struct",
    "target_seq"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## RNA Tertiary Folding

Exact job name: `TertiaryFolding`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdb_id` | string | yes | value | Use the exact source field. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
